item.subject: science
item.stem:
During a storm, strong wind blows fast over the sloping tin roof of Meena's house in Pune.
The air inside the house below the roof is still.
Why can the roof be lifted off?

options.A: The fast wind pushes the roof directly upwards from above.
options.B: The fast-moving air above the roof has lower pressure, so the higher air pressure below the roof pushes it up.
options.C: The still air inside the house has lower pressure than the fast-moving air above.
options.D: The wind increases the pressure equally on both sides of the roof, making it lighter.
